# IT Security Protocol: Encryption Standards and Database Migration

This document outlines critical updates and investigations required for IT security and operational standards.

*   Encryption standards must be updated quarterly.
*   API latency standards require quarterly updates.
*   The API latency standard update needs further investigation.
*   An urgent investigation into the database migration process is required.
